passage.label: Proceed that used deny; proceed shadow smoke three columns; no cool shade availing not against flame; throws sparks huge fortress; yellowish black camels; Woe Day deniers; Day not speak; nor permitted make excuse; Woe Day deniers; Day Judgement assembled you former peoples; if have plan plan against Me; Woe Day deniers

arabicExcerpts.text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ
لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ

mainSubject.label: The command to proceed toward what they denied — a three-columned smoke-shadow offering no cool shade and no protection against flames that throw fortress-sized sparks like yellowish-black camels; woe that Day to the deniers on a Day when they cannot speak nor are permitted to offer excuses; this is the Day of Judgement assembling them with former peoples — if they have a plan let them plan against Allah; woe that Day to the deniers

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the first 'woe to the deniers' refrain after the Day-of-Judgement question (15) before the destruction-and-creation proofs block opens (16); P2 ends with the third 'woe' refrain after the earth-container argument (28) before the punishment-scene command begins (29); P3 runs through the smoke-shadow description, speech prohibition, assembly and planning challenge ending with the sixth 'woe' (40); P4 covers the righteous reward, criminal brief-enjoyment, prayer-refusal and closing Quran-challenge with remaining 'woe' refrains (41-50).
